title: A connected regular scheme is integral
statement: Let $X$ be a regular scheme [def-weil-regular-scheme] (locally Noetherian, with every local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ a regular local ring) whose underlying topological space is nonempty and connected. Then $X$ is integral [def-pc-integral-scheme].
